name: io.github.castaly-ai/mcp-server
title: Modelflare
description: Image and video generation with one Modelflare Smart API Key.

environmentVariables.name: MODELFLARE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Modelflare Smart API Key (create one at https://modelflare.dev/keys)

environmentVariables.name: MODELFLARE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: global (default), china, or a custom base URL

environmentVariables.name: MODELFLARE_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for generated images and videos (default ./modelflare-output)
